payload.prompt: Make a photographic portrait of a woman, preserving the supplied reference's visible facial appearance and short dark bob with fine bangs. Present a distinct surreal photographic concept: an impossible spatial relationship is physically visible in an otherwise ordinary scene. In a nearly empty late-evening laundromat, the woman has just opened a front-loading washing machine and pauses beside it. The machine aperture opens into a full-depth blue-hour sea: a low ocean horizon and a pale distant sky recede far beyond the rubber drum gasket, while one small wave reaches the near inner lip. The round glass door is swung outward on its hinge and remains visibly separate from this deep opening. The floor, the machines beside it, and a half-filled laundry basket remain everyday, tangible objects. She stands at the left of the washer with her torso turned slightly toward the opening. Her nearer hand rests lightly on the outer door rim, fingers naturally separated around the metal edge; her other arm hangs by her side. Her shoulders have stopped mid-routine, her lips gently parted, and her eyes look into the impossible depth. She wears a simple pale blue cotton shirt with loose sleeves and dark straight trousers. Frame her from the upper thighs upward in a horizontal composition, with her face on the left and the large unobstructed washer opening on the right; show the whole hinge and swung-open door within the frame. The aperture occupies about a quarter of the image width. Photograph from a natural standing three-quarter position with a normal lens, keeping her face, fingertips, gasket, and the near wave clearly readable together. Keep both her nearer and farther facial contours visible within the portrait framing. Soft overhead laundromat light makes the skin and cotton tactile; the cooler light from the sea opening falls across her nearer cheek and hand. Let the quiet pause and the single impossible connection carry the photograph, with a restrained palette of warm cream, brushed steel, pale blue and the deep blue sea.
